notes: Checked against Wikidata:Licensing. An item's labels and aliases are structured data in the main namespace, which is CC0, so names may be copied into a concept's aliases (leaving out any that also mean something else) and shown without credit. CC0 covers only the data: discussion and project pages are CC BY-SA 4.0, and a picture an item points to is a Commons file with its own licence (see wikimedia-commons). The Wikidata name and logo are Wikimedia trademarks. Its API is used under Wikimedia's API rules, which ask for a descriptive User-Agent.
